authority: Repository integration boundary only. Future P0 implementation still requires blocking independent review.

field_semantics.user_id: Internal stable subject identifier; never a public display identifier and never sufficient authorization.
field_semantics.display_name: Optional presentation field only; never authorization or economic ownership.
field_semantics.school_id: Optional organizational context only; server-side current membership and eligibility must still be resolved.

shared_identity.authorization_rule: World V2 verifies the token and resolves current team, country, office, suspension, and assignment authority server-side at command acceptance and again where execution-time policy requires it.
prohibited_shared_fields_or_assumptions: team membership as an unverified portable claim
country assignment as an unverified portable claim
office assignment as an unverified portable claim
V1 balances, scores, inventory, contracts, policy state, or world identifiers
shared_identity.lifecycle_rule: Revocation or membership change must deny new World V2 access without deleting immutable economic history; personal-profile deletion must not cascade into World V2 ledger facts.

main_site: League, V1 World, and Legacy World product surfaces
the sole authorized production Supabase migration publication chain
world_v2: one authoritative World V2 World State
World V2 Command/Event/Receipt contracts and authorization boundary
append-only World V2 economic ledger and postings
World V2 projections, APIs, worker execution, and non-authoritative web UI
shared_contract_only: versioned migration artefacts delivered by World V2 and published only by the main-site release chain
never_world_v2_authority: cache, projection, snapshot, replay view, or forecast

main_site_preserved.behavior: remain the existing V1 Simulation World surface
remain the existing League/V1 World surface
remain the explicit Legacy World compatibility surface

world_v2.during_v01: No existing main-site route is rebound, proxied, or silently redirected to World V2.
world_v2.initial_entry: A separately configured World V2 origin may be linked only after its release gate; until then no live entry is claimed.
world_v2.future_same_origin: Requires an approved ADR-19 deployment/auth/cache design and a separately reviewed route change.
world_v2.token_transport: Access or refresh tokens must never be placed in URLs or copied through unrestricted postMessage.

allowed_with_provenance: world map SVG and its provenance record
design tokens and purely presentational styles
pure presentational components with no state, persistence, authorization, or economic imports
static explanatory copy after source/license review
prohibited_as_world_v2_state_or_authorit: V1 or Legacy World database rows, snapshots, identifiers, balances, inventories, contracts, scores, or policy state
V1 Supabase mutations, RPC adapters, Edge Functions, migrations, RLS policies, or service credentials
V1 browser, React, Realtime, cache, or local-storage state
V1 settlement, scoring, policy-effect, calibration, or world-engine outputs
League membership or client role checks as World V2 command authorization
components coupled to V1 persistence or economic behavior
legacy_reuse.copy_rule: Reuse is copy-by-explicit-version with source path, source commit, license/provenance, and content hash; imports may not cross the repository runtime boundary.

world_v2_authoritative_boundary.state_change_path: authorized command -> validated receipt/idempotency -> deterministic worker -> atomic append-only events/postings -> derived projections
forbidden_paths: main site or V1 directly mutates World V2 economic state
League or Legacy World state is imported as World V2 truth
UI, projection, snapshot, cache, replay, or forecast writes authoritative state
a second writer or alternate settlement engine
direct macro buffs without modeled causal flows

production_rule: World V2 never mutates production Supabase or publishes migrations outside an authorized release. Production DDL remains in the main-site publication chain and all P0 review gates remain blocking.
